execute.description: Replace monthly budget value validation for organizational budgets
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."MonthlyBudget" DROP CONSTRAINT "MonthlyBudget_values_check", ADD CONSTRAINT "MonthlyBudget_values_check" CHECK ((("source"='UNCATEGORIZED' AND "amount">=0) OR ("source"<>'UNCATEGORIZED' AND "amount">0)) AND "currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND "source" IN ('TAG','STATEMENTS','CUSTOM','RESERVE','UNCATEGORIZED') AND (("source"='TAG')=("categoryId" IS NOT NULL)) AND "startMonth" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND ("endMonth" IS NULL OR ("endMonth" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND "endMonth">="startMonth")))

label: Allow organizational budgets without a positive amount
